=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Per CLAUDE.md §20.B, "One fragment per PR. Never reuse another PR's filename — the unique path is the whole point." The conformance fix widens the pickup's per-wake API budget from the first `limit` targets to the first 30 targets (3 × limit), which is exactly the class of threshold and behaviour change §20.A lists as requiring a fragment.
  Expected change site: A new fragment file at `changelog.d/4649-stuck-unbound-items.md` (or any other uniquely-named, never-before-used path under `changelog.d/`) carrying its own `<!-- changelog: fixed -->` marker, a headline, lead paragraph, numbers table, and audience paragraph for this conformance fix.
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff modifies `changelog.d/4621-bind-claude-queue-payloads.md` (the fragment introduced by PR #4639, which already merged), editing only one table cell. No new `changelog.d/4649-*.md` exists in the PR changed-files list or in the diff. The existing fragment's headline ("The Claude issue pickup now starts only queue items that match what the run that queued them recorded") and lead paragraph still describe PR #4639's security fix; the conformance fix inherits only the updated table number and has no standalone entry. When `scripts/assemble_changelog.py` folds fragments into `CHANGELOG.md` at release time, the single mutated file produces one merged entry that retroactively rewrites the documented per-wake API budget for PR #4639 instead of producing two distinct entries.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
